title: Semantic encoder lifecycle: onboarding protocol, blackbox validation, and graceful sunset
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Define and implement a repeatable lifecycle for onboarding new embedding/encoder models and retiring older variants with minimal customer disruption and clear quality/latency guardrails. This ticket covers the end-to-end protocol: offline validation, runtime compatibility checks, staged traffic rollouts (shadow -> canary -> ramp), per-tenant pinning/graceful fallback, deprecation calendar, and observability/alerting needed to make safe decisions.

Scope:
- Blackbox & whitebox quality validation (offline benchmarks + unit contract tests).
- Latency and throughput regression testing with realistic batching and KV cache warmups.
- Canary and staggered tenant activation policies tied to automated metrics.
- Deprecation playbook: communication template, per-tenant sunset opt-out, and automated migration helpers.
- Telemetry contract: semantic drift (cosine delta), recall@K and MRR baselines, latency P50/P95/P99, error rates, and memory/KV-hit metrics.

Motivation and trade-offs:
- New models improve semantics and cost but may regress specific tenants (domain-specific vocab). To avoid blunt rollouts, we build per-tenant gating with opt-in and safety rollbacks.
- Strict latency SLOs mean we must validate quantized variants and batching interactions; in some cases we may keep an older lower-latency variant available as fallback.
- Fast rollouts accelerate value delivery but increase risk of quality regressions; automated guardrails and human-in-the-loop signoffs reduce blast radius.

Acceptance Criteria: (see acceptance_criteria field)

Deliverables:
- Onboarding checklist document (Confluence) with mandatory offline datasets and required contract tests.
- Runtime compatibility test suite (GitHub) that can run in CI and in canary staging.
- Telemetry dashboards (Console) showing drift, quality deltas, and cost delta per tenant.
- Canary policy implementation supporting: shadowing, %-based canaries, tenant pinning, and automatic rollback triggers.
- Deprecation automation that notifies affected tenants and provides migration steps and a grace period.

acceptance_criteria: Offline evaluation reports for candidate model vs. baseline on standard sets (MS MARCO, internal taxonomy + 5 tenant-specific seed sets).
Performance regression tests: P95 latency difference < 10% on representative batch sizes and KV-cache warm/steady states.
Contract tests: API shape, embedding dimensionality and hashing/stable-seed behaviour preserved or mapped via documented adapter.
Canary flow deployed: 0%->shadow->5%->25% with automated rollback if quality delta or latency error thresholds breached.
Per-tenant pinning form exposed in Console and API with ability to pin to old variant for 30 days post-rollout.
Deprecation notice automation that emails + in-console banner to affected tenants 90/60/30/7 days before sunset.
Telemetry dashboards show baseline, candidate, and delta lines for recall@10, MRR, cosine-drift, P95 latency, and cost-per-embed.
Security review completed and KMS/PII impact documented if model collects or processes customer-provided examples.
steps: Assemble offline benchmark corpus including public sets and tenant-provided seeds
Run baseline vs candidate offline evals (semantic similarity, recall@K, MRR, NDCG)
Instrument runtime to capture KV hits, kernel selection stats, batching size distribution and token throughput
Add contract tests to CI for tensor shapes, dimension checks, and deterministic hashing
Deploy candidate in shadow mode (no traffic impact) and collect metrics for 48-72h
If shadow looks good, enable canary at 5% traffic with per-tenant sampling for 48h
Ramp canary to 25% and validate drift/latency/cost deltas; run human eval on random sample
Open rollout for wider adoption and enable tenant pinning UI; schedule deprecation calendar
Run post-rollout review and postmortem if any rollback occurred
testing_plan: Unit contract tests for embedding shape and version header in response
Integration tests exercising batching under realistic burst profiles (simulated traffic traces)
End-to-end smoke test covering: request -> runtime -> KV cache -> metrics emission
Chaos test: simulate a kernel fallback to quantized path and ensure service stays within latency SLOs
A/B online evaluation harness comparing candidate vs baseline using traffic-split and seeded queries
rollback_triggers: manual report from a tenant flagged high-severity for domain regression
communication_plan: Draft deprecation + onboarding emails with recommended migration steps
Console banner templates for notice windows 90/60/30/7 days
Support playbook for tenant requests to pin, rollback or request private model variants
Public changelog entry with migration notes and performance expectations
